_meta.what: Second-tier ★★ pieces the mirrored guide lists for the Taiwanese server that have NO item in our client yet. Kept apart from data/star-gear.json, which is client-only, so the page can say which pieces are real in our files and which are only announced.
_meta.source: roz-global.info guide (docs/rozglobal-export/pages/guide-armes-armures-etoiles.html), citing the TWROZ announcement of 28 Aug 2025; read 2026-09-25. French text translated by hand; every number copied as printed.
_meta.note: The guide prints the same effect text for ★★ Lute — Résonance and ★★ Wire Whip — Dispersion; that is what the source says, not a copy error here.
